journey.name: Paste-to-Import — parse, publish, undo window
journey.description: The v1 primary import flow (spec §5): paste tab-separated lines, preview parsed cards, publish to the homeserver, observe the 10-second undo window, finish to deck detail. Requires a signed-in session (run journey 01 first).

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and verify the Home screen is shown
Open the Decks tab from the bottom tab bar
Tap the paste-import call-to-action card ("Paste cards" entry point)
Verify the "Paste cards" screen is shown with a text area placeholder "Paste your list here"
Type the following three lines into the paste field: "dog cachorro", "cat gato", "bird pássaro" (tab-separated)
Verify a live preview appears showing 3 parsed cards with fronts dog, cat, bird
Enter "Animals PT" as the deck title if a title field is shown
Verify a "Deck published!" success state appears with an "Undo" button showing a live countdown (e.g. "Undo (9s)") and a "Done" button
Verify the deck detail screen for "Animals PT" is shown with 3 cards
